name: sidekick-panel
description: A Sidekick pane: type a question about this conversation, with an image if you like, and get an answer from a fork of the session's own transcript, or ask for work and press Do it to have a helper do it with tools; the line and the result stay in the pane, out of the chat

showPane.title: Show the Sidekick pane
showPane.description: The side pane with the question box. Off: it never opens by itself, an open pane shows no question box, nothing is kept and /sidekick-panel says it is off.

effort.title: How hard the Sidekick pane thinks
effort.description: session: as hard as the main work, and the answer reads the conversation from the prompt cache. A fixed level can make the first answer at that level re-send the whole conversation once.
